title: AI Agents Don’t Need the Entire Codebase. They Need the Right Context.
description: Task-specific evidence, semantic navigation, current worktrees, and inspectable context packets—without mistaking more text for better understanding.
author: Jordan Davis
coverAlt: Right context. Not more noise. Decisions, symbols, contracts, and tests form a scoped task packet.
coverCaption: Editorial illustration. The context explorer uses fictional evidence, not a live repository or model benchmark.
